name: Mirkwood Trapper — "It gets +2/+0" is the chosen attacker, not a player
notes: Found by tests/sweep.py. 'Whenever a player attacks, … that player chooses an attacking creature. It gets +2/+0 until end of turn.' rewrote 'It' to 'target player' because the trigger condition names 'a player', and a player is no permanent, so nothing was emitted. A player is no longer taken as the pronoun's subject. The chosen Bears are 4/2; the Trapper is untouched.

call: if they aren't attacking you, that player chooses an attacking creature. It gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
